title: Me dijo que estaba cansada
goal: a contar lo que te dijo alguien con said y told, dando al verbo un paso atrás

vocab.note: News va en singular: the news is good. Una noticia = a piece of news.

ex.t: Have you heard the latest gossip?
She sent me a five-minute voice message!
ex.es: ¡Me mandó un audio de cinco minutos!

ex.t: Text me when you get home.
ex.es: Mándame un mensaje cuando llegues a casa.

ex.t: She whispered that it was a secret.
Don't shout, I can hear you!
Apparently, the new baker is from Italy.
ex.es: Por lo visto, el panadero nuevo es italiano.

ex.t: By the way, your sister called.
ex.es: Por cierto, ha llamado tu hermana.

pron.title: El was flojito
pron.tip: En el estilo indirecto, was casi no se oye: «uəs». She said she was tired → «shi-SED-shi-uəs-TAIRD». La fuerza va en said y en tired.

exercises.q: My friend ___ me she was pregnant!
"I work in a bank." → He said he ___ in a bank.
"We'll come at six." → They said they ___ come at six.
She ___ that the news was true.
exercises.es: Dijo que la noticia era verdad.

exercises.q: "I can't find my keys." → He said he ___ find his keys.
exercises.es: Dijo que no encontraba las llaves.

exercises.q: "I love your cooking." → He told me he loved ___ cooking.
exercises.es: Me dijo que le encantaba mi cocina.
exercises.why: Your (lo que él dijo) → my (lo cuento yo).

exercises.q: My son told that he was coming home.
exercises.why: Sin persona detrás: said. (O told me.)

exercises.q: She said she is very tired last night.
exercises.why: Lo dijo anoche: un paso atrás, was.

exercises.instr: Cuéntalo empezando por My friend said…
answer: My friend said she was moving to Málaga.
My friend said that she was moving to Málaga.
My friend said he was moving to Málaga.
My friend said that he was moving to Málaga.

exercises.instr: Cuéntalo empezando por He told me…
answer: He told me he would text me.
He told me that he would text me.

exercises.q: Por lo visto, dijo que estaba muy contenta.
answer: Apparently, she said she was very happy.
Apparently she said she was very happy.
Apparently, she said that she was very happy.
Apparently she said that she was very happy.
exercises.why: Apparently = por lo visto; estaba = was.

exercises.context: Tu amiga te mandó un audio: «I can't come tomorrow». Se lo cuentas a tu marido.
options: She said me she can't come.
exercises.why: Said sin persona y can't → couldn't.

exercises.title: WhatsApp de una amiga
exercises.text: Guess who called me? Our old neighbour! She said she was coming to Spain in June. She told me she wanted to see everyone. Apparently, she's learning Spanish! By the way, she asked about you. 😊

questions.q: ¿Cuándo viene la antigua vecina a España?

exercises.es: Me dijo que estaba muy cansado
exercises.answer: He told me he was very tired
exercises.why: Me dijo = told me; estaba = was.

dialog.title: El audio de cinco minutos
dialog.setting: En un café de Londres, Yolanda le cuenta a Emma el audio que le ha mandado una amiga

lines.t: Who sent you that long voice message?
lines.es: ¿Quién te ha mandado ese audio tan largo?

lines.t: My friend from the village. She has big news!
lines.es: Mi amiga del pueblo. ¡Tiene una noticia gorda!

lines.t: Ooh, tell me! What did she say?
She said her daughter was getting married.
lines.es: Dijo que su hija se casaba.

lines.t: She told me the wedding was in September.
lines.es: Me dijo que la boda era en septiembre.

lines.t: Yes! She said she would send the invitation soon.
lines.es: ¡Sí! Dijo que me mandaría la invitación pronto.

realLife.t: She told me she was coming next week.
realLife.es: Me dijo que venía la semana que viene.
realLife.context: Para contarle a alguien lo que te dijo otra persona por teléfono

summary: Un paso atrás: am/is → was, are → were, will → would, can → could
Presente simple → pasado simple: I work → he worked
Para charlar: apparently, by the way, voice message, gossip
